description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Holy/Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Holy/Fire, Unlimited Holy/Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Holy/Fire Abilities, Holy/Fire Ability Damage +30% & 20% DEF/RES Pierce to Holy/Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Holy/Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Holy/NE or Fire/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Thorns of the Rose (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Holy/Fire/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & 30% DEF/RES Pierce to Holy/Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with 0-1/2+ levels of Attach Holy/Fire
WS Blue: [Lv.2 En-Holy/Fire Stack] to user
WS Gold: [During Tactical Awoken Mode, Holy/Fire Ability Damage +50% & Quick Holy/Fire] to user
